subject: Can RenderDataTable be downloaded to local?

messages.author: 3fdc02da1ddc82a5
messages.subject: Can RenderDataTable be downloaded to local?
parts:
Hi ,

I had a shiny app, by following the BasicDataTable example (http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/basic-datatable.html. At this time, I'd like to add an action button to download the file into .txt to my local place.

But it seems like it doesn't work by calling the output directly. I got the error as "Reading objects from shinyoutput object not allowed."

So I wonder if I need to write a reactive one instead.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Can RenderDataTable be downloaded to local?
parts: That's right, you'd make a reactive expression that returns the data, and use that reactive expression both from renderDataTable and from your downloadHandler.
